cards.what: An empirical study of the instruction stacks (instructions, tool definitions, context) in the first model requests of 1,886 releases of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and OpenCode. top.headline: Claude Code 2.1.312 fixes skills lookup and large CLAUDE.md overwrites

Fixes include Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file after seeing only its start (Write now asks it to read it all or edit in place), and per-directory and paths: skills not being found after a Bash cd deeper into a git repository.

top.headline: Study maps the hidden instruction stacks that coding agents send to models
top.summary: Coding agents send models more than the user's prompt: added instructions, tool definitions and environmental context form an instruction stack. The paper says this stack steers execution and changes across releases, yet is largely unexposed to users and insufficiently characterized.
top.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: an Empirical Study about The Instruction Stacks of Coding Agents
top.why: Context management and harness behaviour are your top topics, and this is an empirical look at what actually reaches the model.
